sources.publisher: TokenPost — Two Ripple Accounts Still Hold 1 Billion XRP Ahead of Nov. 1
claims: Two Ripple-labelled XRPL accounts each showed a 500M XRP balance on Oct29.
Four EscrowFinish transactions on Oct1 delivered 100M+400M to one account and 200M+300M to the other.
The report found no later outgoing XRP payment from either account through its Oct29 observation.
The same two accounts were associated with two Nov1 escrow objects containing another 500M each.
limitations: Wallet balances are dated Oct29, not a fresh Oct31 raw account-state check.
No sale, exchange deposit, OTC sale or current balance is established.
The 2B framing is 1B previously released and held plus 1B still escrowed/eligible, not 2B already unlocked or sold.
